title: [IMP-15] Space state schema is scattered and missing fields that signature checks need
description: Review finding IMP-15: Space state schema is scattered and missing fields that signature checks need (lens IMP). Location: spec/03-spaces.md:51-145; spec/04-access-control.md:14, :16, :121; spec/05-messaging.md:318; spec/09-interop.md:53, :99. Fix: As proposed, with two additions. (1) The SpaceState example has no member list or member-to-role assignment, which §4.2 role assignment and JMAP Chat SpaceMember `roleIds` need. (2) JMAP Chat leaves the admin predicate "deployment-defined" (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00:337), so Agora must define it. Either an explicit `admins` list or a stated mapping from SpaceRole permissions (`manage_space`, `manage_members`, `manage_channels`) to admin scope would work. Reusing roles and permissions is the smaller change, consistent with 03:135. Full text: notes/review/IMP-verified.md and notes/review/IMP.md.
